description:
Configures SSO and Just In Time (JIT) registation for enrolled devices. Users will need to sign-in to an app after enrolment to support device registration and capture of the SSO token. For customers using Microsoft Defender this should not be the first application opened.

https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/intune/device-configuration/settings-catalog/configure-enterprise-sso-plugin-ios
https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/intune/device-enrollment/apple/ref-automated-authentication-methods#option-3-just-in-time-registration-for-setup-assistant-with-modern-authentication
name: POC_IOS_D_BYOD_SSO_AppExtension
